Switch ghost mode on or off
splitstone.replayui.tutorial.welcome.tex: The replay is paused while you learn the controls. Do the tasks on each step, then press Next. Skip Tutorial leaves at any time.
splitstone.replayui.tutorial.timeline.te: This strip is the whole match. The bright line with the knob is where you are now, and the small icons mark moments such as portals, deaths and resets. Click or drag on it to jump.
Press this button to start or stop the replay, or press {key:play_pause}.
splitstone.replayui.tutorial.skip.title: Skip Back and Ahead
splitstone.replayui.tutorial.skip.text: These buttons move the replay {skip} seconds back or ahead. The keys are {key:seek_back} and {key:seek_forward}.
Jump to an exact time. Open the box with this button or press {key:go_to_time}.
splitstone.replayui.tutorial.using_go_to: Type minutes, seconds and milliseconds into the boxes (Tab or the arrow keys move between them), then press {enter} or click GO.
splitstone.replayui.tutorial.speed.title: Playback Speed
splitstone.replayui.tutorial.speed.text: Watch anywhere from {min_speed} to {max_speed}. Open the slider with this button. The keys {key:speed_down} (slower) and {key:speed_up} (faster) nudge it.
splitstone.replayui.tutorial.splits.text: One table shows when each runner reached every split. Open it with this button or press {key:splits}.
splitstone.replayui.tutorial.using_split: Click a time to jump there and follow that runner. A dash means they never got there.
splitstone.replayui.tutorial.align.title: Align Splits
splitstone.replayui.tutorial.align.text: Start runners from the same split to watch them race through it together. Open Align Splits with this button or press {key:align_splits}.
splitstone.replayui.tutorial.using_align: Choose a start and an end split, tick the runners and press Align. The others play as ghosts.
splitstone.replayui.tutorial.clearing_al: While runners are aligned this panel offers Clear Alignment. Press it to return to normal playback.
splitstone.replayui.tutorial.pathing.tex: Trails show where runners and mobs have been. Open the menu with this button or press {key:pathing}.
splitstone.replayui.tutorial.using_pathi: Choose who leaves a trail. Open Runner Paths and switch one on or off.
splitstone.replayui.tutorial.camera_slid: Two sliders set how far behind the runner the third-person camera sits (Zoom) and how fast the free camera flies (Camera speed). Open them with this button.
splitstone.replayui.tutorial.using_camer: Drag a slider, or scroll over it. In partial or hidden UI the wheel adjusts the one that fits your camera.
splitstone.replayui.tutorial.camera_mode: Watch through the runner's eyes, from behind in third person, or from anywhere with the free camera. Choose one of these, or cycle with {key:switch_camera}. Try third person.
splitstone.replayui.tutorial.reset_camer: Flown off or turned around? Press {key:reset_camera} to bring the camera back to the runner you follow.
splitstone.replayui.tutorial.switch_play: Follow another runner from this selector, or press {key:switch_player} for the next one.
Ghost mode shows the other runners as see-through figures in the world you are watching, so you can compare routes. Switch it with this button or press {key:ghosts}.
splitstone.replayui.tutorial.settings.te: Every replay option lives here. Open it with this button or press {key:options}.
splitstone.replayui.tutorial.using_setti: Switch name tags, tooltips, mob labels, X-rays and more on or off, and set the defaults. Changes apply at once. Press Next to carry on.
splitstone.replayui.tutorial.inventory.t: Press {key:inventory} to open the inventory of the runner you follow. It shows from their eyes only, so the tutorial has switched you to first person.
splitstone.replayui.tutorial.using_inven: You see what the runner had open at this moment, armour and items included. Press {key:inventory} again to close it.
splitstone.replayui.tutorial.ui_modes.te: The UI is full (this bar), partial (a few small boxes) or hidden. Press {key:cycle_ui} to go forward through them and {key:cycle_ui_back} to go back. Return to the full UI to continue.
splitstone.replayui.tutorial.moving_arou: The camera moves only while the UI is partial or hidden, because the full UI needs your mouse. Switch to partial, pick the free camera and fly with {mc:forward}, {mc:left}, {mc:back} and {mc:right}, then come back to full.
Press {esc} to open the pause menu. The replay keeps playing behind it.
splitstone.replayui.tutorial.tutorial_bu: This button runs the tutorial again.
Totals and breakdowns of what each runner did in this match, in tabs.
splitstone.replayui.tutorial.open_in_cre: Makes a Creative world from the replay's world, with the runner as they are now. It is unavailable while ghosts are on or the replay is live.
splitstone.replayui.tutorial.replay_cont: Every key of the viewer can be changed here. This tutorial always shows the keys you have set.
splitstone.replayui.tutorial.done.title: Tutorial Done
